column1: # PHerc1447-seed11, the one tree where BOTH binaries finished. untouched_sha256 is the run of the binary that wrote the study's sheets, started 2026-09-21T12:37Z under tools/finish_seed.sh with no cap and ended at 18:49:05Z after about 6 h 12 of c stage; c2_arm_sha256 is the run of c-stage-cost's c2 binary, corrections 00007 00008 and 00009, whose c stage took 128.0 s on a fresh copy of the same growth tree. This is the identity check the study could not make: its 585 rows cover the six seeds where both binaries finish, and seed11's fan out of 33.97 is above every one of them.
